raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Embedding lookup is 0 MACs, so that `*2` multiplier shouldn't be there (the mac to flop 2x multiplier is already in the `6*` multiplier later.

Alternatively, instead of explaining via a comment, could rename the variable to drop the `emb_and_` prefix, then it's self-documenting.

## Code Review

This pull request correctly updates the FLOPs calculation by removing the MACs from the embedding lookup, which is a valid optimization as embedding layers are look-up tables. The changes are applied consistently across multiple model estimation functions. I've added suggestions to rename the `emd_and_lm_head_N` variable as you proposed in the description. This will improve code clarity and maintainability by making the variable name accurately reflect its new purpose.

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

As you mentioned in the pull request description, renaming `emd_and_lm_head_N` would make the code more self-documenting now that it no longer includes parameters for the embedding layer. Renaming it to `lm_head_N` would improve clarity.

```suggestion
        lm_head_N = vocab_size * hidden_size
        # non-attn all_layer parm
        dense_N = (mlp_N + attn_linear_N) * num_hidden_layers + lm_head_N
```
